svg.aria-label: Accessibility and design: Light by default; dark only when chosen (remembered per device). Text contrast meets WCAG AA; grades always print their letter, so they read without colour. Keyboard focus is always visible; motion turns off for people who ask for less motion. Brand rules: brand/guidelines.

g.text: Light by default; dark only when chosen (remembered per device).
Text contrast meets WCAG AA; grades always print their letter, so they read without colour.
Keyboard focus is always visible; motion turns off for people who ask for less motion.
